title: Forth Drafts and Fragments
description: Unfinished programs, experiments, and small tools from the 1982 MMSFORTH disks.
versionOrder: Disk saves have no recorded order or dates beyond their source comments. Any ordering here is a presentation guess.

versions.label: Conquest (blocks 45-51)
versions.note: Space strategy game in progress. No start word; some characters are stored as z, j, and p.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
